unverified_leads.note: Lead was '/ch01.264' — confirmed; note official MJPEG variant is /h264/media.amp (H.264->MJPEG mode), NOT the Axis 'mpeg4/media.amp?resolution=640x480' lead
Axis-flavoured lead; not in Xvision docs. Xvision's only media.amp form is /h264/media.amp for the MJPEG stream — the resolution query string is Axis contamination

notes: Xvision is a UK-designed brand owned/manufactured by Y3K (Australia HQ), so Y3K's support KB is the manufacturer's own official documentation. Xvision is a multi-OEM line: X2C/X4C/X5C use /ch00/<0|1>; XC720/XC1080 use /ch01.264 & /ch01_sub.264; X/XP720/XP1080 are Dahua-OEM using /cam/realmonitor. NVR/DVR channels use /ip0<N>/0 (main) & /ip0<N>/1 (sub) — not included above (device is a recorder, not a camera). Default port 554 across all families. Both '/ch00/0' and '/ch00/1' leads confirmed exactly.
